main_text.l: Tertium futurum. Noli vel nolito, nolite vel noli-
Secunda forma Verbi est, quando Thema definit
in or. Ac si Latinè flecti possit in o,dicitur verbu pas-
sivum : ut, Amor, ich werde geliebet/ amo, ich liebe.
Si non possit Latinè flecti in o,dicitur Verbum Depo-
nens: ut Loquor,ich rede : Loquo non dicimus. Sunt
efferri pero & or, eadem significatione: ut, Assentio &
assentior,ich stimme zu/ich halte es mit einem. Imper-
tio & impertior, ich theile mit. Comperio & compe-
rior, ich erfahre/ ich werde innen. Usus artium Magi-
Conjuga vulgaria Verba formæ secundæ, juxta quæ
Amor, ich werde geliebet / amaris vel amare, du
Doceor,ich werde gelehret/ doceris vel docēre,do-

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) used for the German glosses; rendered here in roman type without <bl> tags because the German words are a gloss throughout, and the Fraktur is only partly legible. The Latin-to-German glosses in the paragraph beginning "Secunda forma" and in the conjugation lines are set in Fraktur and may contain misread letters. Ink stain near the top right margin; no text lost. Words "Malebā", "Noluerā", "Maluisse" and "Nolle" are plausible readings of the cursive-like print and may need checking. Mixed Latin and German; the German words are reproduced as read.
